successCriteria.description: The `ILeaveRequestService` interface exposes exactly 8 methods: `createDraft(dto: CreateLeaveRequestDto): Promise<LeaveRequest>`, `submit(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>`, `approve(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>`, `reject(id: string, approverId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>`, `cancel(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest>`, `findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveRequest | null>`, `findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>`, `query(params: LeaveRequestQueryParams): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>`

`createDraft` validates employee exists, policy exists and isActive, startDate <= endDate, then creates a LeaveRequest with status DRAFT; rejects with typed error `{ error, code }` on any validation failure

`submit` enforces the state machine (only DRAFT → SUBMITTED), checks minimumNoticeDays (calendar-day based: `now + policy.minimumNoticeDays`), verifies balance exists and is not CLOSED, checks `remainingDays >= daysRequested` using the BINDING formula `(endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1`, then transitions to SUBMITTED

`approve` enforces only SUBMITTED → APPROVED, validates `approverId === employee.managerId`, deducts `daysRequested` from balance (`usedDays += daysRequested`, `remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays`), sets `approvedBy`, `approvedAt`, and status APPROVED
`reject` enforces only SUBMITTED → REJECTED, validates `approverId === employee.managerId`, sets status REJECTED without touching balance

`cancel` enforces SUBMITTED or APPROVED → CANCELLED; if APPROVED, restores `usedDays -= daysRequested` and recalculates `remainingDays = totalEntitlement - usedDays`; sets `cancelledAt` and status CANCELLED

All invalid state transitions (DRAFT→APPROVED, DRAFT→REJECTED, APPROVED→SUBMITTED, REJECTED→CANCELLED, APPROVED→REJECTED, CANCELLED→anything) are rejected with `{ error, code: 'INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION' }`

The BINDING day-counting formula `(endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) + 1` is used at every call site that computes `daysRequested` — submit balance check, approve deduction, cancel restoration — and produces correct results for single-day (1), multi-day (5 for Mon–Fri), and multi-week (12 for 10–21 Aug) ranges
Read-only methods `findById`, `findByEmployeeId`, `query` delegate directly to the corresponding repository methods without additional business logic

constraints: The `LeaveRequestService` constructor MUST accept exactly four dependencies in this order: `ILeaveRequestRepository`, `ILeaveBalanceRepository`, `ILeavePolicyRepository`, `IEmployeeRepository`
All errors thrown by the service MUST use the shape `{ error: string; code: string }` — no exceptions, no custom Error subclasses, no string-only throws

The service MUST NOT inject or depend on notification, audit, or any other repository/service beyond the four declared constructor dependencies — notification and audit integration is deferred to Phase 10

entityInvariants.invariant: Lifecycle state machine: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (APPROVED | REJECTED); SUBMITTED or APPROVED → CANCELLED. No other transitions are valid. The service must reject any transition not in this set.
